task: Fix regen-screens-catalog.mjs vm-sandbox ReferenceError + masked screen-id collisions (T7)
root_cause: vm.runInNewContext() sandbox context for parsing vitana-v1 ADMIN_SECTIONS was a hardcoded 12-identifier object; any other free identifier (icon name) threw ReferenceError and aborted the whole regen script.
fix: Replaced all three vm.runInNewContext contexts in the file with a Proxy that resolves any free identifier to a harmless stub value (0) instead of throwing. Also added 6 missing idOverrides disambiguator entries (3 DEV, 3 ADM) that the crash had been masking.
